dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: This year's Wellness Week comes with forty pages of instructions.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I actually like the quiet-room idea. Sometimes I think I need permission to stop helping people.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Well, they can begin by giving me permission to fix that damper.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: You'll get your ten minutes after the first session.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: That's in three hours. The damper doesn't need a lecture.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: All the chairs are over the access hatch.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The schedule says this room is reserved for guided relaxation.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Move the first session and we lose our attendance slot.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Move the chairs and I can fix the vent before attendance becomes a problem.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Give them one block. I know you're right about the damper.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: They turned the old storage room into a quiet room.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Does someone have to sign in?

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: No. I can record that it's in use without recording who is here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: That might be the best thing we've invented all week.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I think I could sit here for an hour.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: You'd be at the door inviting people in after four minutes.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: The system says I completed a wellness exercise.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Twenty-two uninterrupted minutes in an approved relaxation chair.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I was asleep.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Then you've managed the one activity we didn't schedule a meeting about.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Does the certificate come with another nap?

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: My rig's water temperature is climbing. Is anyone going to fix the air in here?

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: I can. They put the relaxation seats in front of the service hatch.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: You don't have to attend if you're uncomfortable.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: I wasn't attending. I was trying to get to the other side of the room.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I'll make sure the doorway stays clear. You decide whether to stay.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: The temperature's higher at the door than the return grille. Their baseline is already compromised.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Can you get a useful reading without turning Noola into an experiment?

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I'm reading the room, Astra. Noola is perfectly capable of telling us it's too warm.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The corporate form asks for perceived comfort.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: Then it should ask the people who are comfortable enough to be in here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We can begin. Nobody is required to describe anything personal.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I was looking forward to this, actually.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: Then enjoy it. You don't need an audience.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: The vent's still rattling behind that wall.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The exit is available if anyone needs it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: Good. The first sensible part of the program.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: I'm leaving. The water temperature is still going up.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Would you like someone to go with you?

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: No. I'm not declaring independence; I'm going somewhere cooler.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I'll check the return temperature after they clear the chairs.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Anyone else who needs to leave, leave. We'll fix the room first.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: The attendance count is meaningless if the room isn't safe for the people using it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: May I have the wall now?

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I can move the chairs. I helped put them here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: Let's measure it after repair, so we know what actually changed.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I can carry the chairs. I'm certified to relax afterward.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Where do these cushions go? They weren't here yesterday.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: They were under the folding table. I put them out.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: I'll need the table moved too.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The program clock has ended.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: That's a relief. I was afraid we'd have to finish something before we started work.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: The damper actuator wasn't seating. Give me ten minutes.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: The temperatures ought to equalize as soon as the return is open.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We've delayed the repair most of a morning for an hour of calm.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: It's a lovely concept. The room was yelling at me the whole time.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Temperature back within range. It's quieter now, too.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: That's better. I can actually stand here without the water rig complaining.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I preferred the warm room. The nap was excellent.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: You slept through my entire repair.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: That's the highest compliment I can pay your work.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Are you staying for the next session?

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: I'm staying because the room is pleasant. That seems sufficient.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: The report says we had unusually low participation.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: It also says the room was too hot. People were right to leave.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I can separate attendance from physical conditions.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Do. I want the report to resemble the day we actually had.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I never thought I'd be relieved to have so few records.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I got a certificate for taking a nap, and now someone wants my personal wellness goal.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: You can leave it blank. The form permits that.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: My goal is to reach the end of the day without another stranger describing my water.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I'll mark these as different kinds of participation, not different degrees of virtue.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I just wanted to see whether this room was actually being used.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: It was, until three people came to check.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I didn't think I'd like sitting quietly. It turns out I do.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: You haven't stopped talking since I arrived.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I'll leave you to it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I was about to say that.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: The only unambiguous trend is the damper failed before the session and worked afterward.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: That sounds exactly like what I repaired.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Wellness activity did not change the mechanical trace.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Good. Then we won't give the breathing exercise credit for your wrench.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I like science much more when it disagrees politely.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I'm sending what happened, including the bad temperature and the repair.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: Not a theory about what people felt while it was hot.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: And not a list of names who didn't attend.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I wish there were a way to tell them the quiet room was actually nice.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: You just did. You told me. That counts here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Central says low disclosure means the program was insufficiently engaging.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: They weren't here. The room was too hot and the service hatch was blocked.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: They've proposed additional personal reflection.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Tell them we've completed the physical repair. Don't invent feelings to improve the graph.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I still think there's something good about people having time to rest.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: There is. You don't have to turn it into data for it to exist.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We can keep the quiet room. We can also keep the rest of the station working.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I'd prefer that. I was almost beginning to enjoy being alone.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Here's the attendance card. I signed where it asked.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: You left the personal reflection blank.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: My reflections are generally private, especially when I'm sleeping.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: That's permitted. I can close the record.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Please file my certificate where nobody can use it against me.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Branding is down. I can finally see the air return.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Can we leave one sign for the quiet room? People actually used that space.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: A plain sign. Not a questionnaire.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Fine. The room stays. The seminar goes.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We've received next week's initiative: Bring Your Feelings to Work Day.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Can I bring them in a sealed container?

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: Do yours require refrigeration?

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I knew I should've taken tomorrow off.
